sentences.japanese: 橋の建設の入札が募られた。
sentences.english: Bids were solicited for the building of the bridge.

sentences.japanese: 会社は退職者を募った。
sentences.english: The company appealed for people to take voluntary resignation.

sentences.japanese: ６月末に参加者を募ったら１週間弱で約５００席が予約でいっぱいになった。
sentences.english: When participants were sought at the end of June all, about 500, seats were reserved in under a week.

sentences.japanese: 社会保険庁や厚生労働省への不信感は募る一方である。
sentences.english: Distrust of the Social Insurance Agency and the Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare just keeps getting stronger.

sentences.japanese: 世界の航空産業は墜落事故についての懸念を募らせている。
sentences.english: The world's aviation industry is growing increasingly worried about crashes.
